title: Settings
intro: Paste your {gatewayName} gateway API key from {gatewayHost} to run chat and job modes on the {workspaceName} desk. Chat, keys and threads stay on this desk.
introNeedsKey: Paste the key from your {gatewayName} account.
gatewayHelp: Paste your gateway API key for this desk. It never comes back after save.
saved: Saved. Keys stay on this desk.
loadFailed: Could not load your settings. Reload the page to try again.
saveFailed: Could not save your settings. Try again in a moment.
localeFailed: Could not change the language. Try again in a moment.
privacy: Prompts leave this machine only over HTTPS to {gatewayHost}. {productName} does not log prompts. Keys and threads are encrypted on disk. {gatewayName} retention is the gateway's policy.
languageHelp: Applies after you restart Nultron. Chat and job modes follow this language.
gateway.grace: Working offline with a key verified on {date}.
gateway.checkFailed: Could not re-check the gateway right now. Try again in a moment.
reset.heading: Start over
reset.help: Forget the gateway key on this machine, or delete everything and get the fresh-install experience back.
reset.signOutHelp: Forgets the saved key on every desk and sends you back to the first-run screen. Threads, desks, knowledge, and files stay.
reset.signOutConfirm: Sign out of the gateway? The saved key is forgotten on every desk and you will be asked for a key again. Nothing else is deleted.
reset.freshInstallHelp: Deletes every bit of local data and restarts {productName} on the first-run screen.
reset.freshInstallWarning: This deletes every thread, desk, knowledge base, generated image and video, and the saved gateway key on this machine. {productName} restarts on the first-run screen. This cannot be undone.
reset.restarting: {productName} is restarting. The reset finishes as it comes back up.
reset.restartNeeded: Restart {productName} to finish the reset. On the dev server, stop it and start it again.
reset.restartRefused: {productName} could not restart just now ({reason}). Close it and open it again to finish the reset.
reset.pending: A full reset is queued for the next launch.
reset.pendingCancelled: The queued reset is called off. Nothing will be deleted.
reset.failed: Could not finish that just now. Try again in a moment.
reset.eraseAccountHelp: Permanently deletes this company account: every desk, thread, file and saved key, and every person who uses it. Everyone is signed out. Your plan, seats and billing history are kept.
reset.eraseAccountWarning: This permanently deletes the company account and everything in it: every desk, thread, file, generated image and video, and the saved gateway key.
reset.eraseAccountWarningPeople: Every person in the company is deleted and signed out on every device, including you. Nobody will be able to open this data again.
reset.eraseAccountContract: Erasing the company account is governed by your service contract.
reset.eraseAccountTypeToConfirm: The final button stays disabled until you type {phrase} exactly as shown, in capital letters.
reset.eraseAccountForbidden: Only an owner of this company can erase it. Ask an owner to do it.
reset.eraseAccountShared: This server holds several companies under one account, so an erase from here would delete all of them. Nothing has been deleted. Ask the operator of this server to erase this company.
reset.eraseAccountDone: The company account has been erased. You are being signed out.
storage.heading: Storage
storage.help: How much space this account is using, and what is using it.
storage.low: You are close to the limit. Delete something to make room.
storage.full: You have used all of your storage. Delete something before uploading again.
storage.empty: Nothing is stored on this account yet.
keyRestricted: Only an owner or admin can change the company key.
introRestricted: Chat and job modes on the {workspaceName} desk run on your company's {gatewayName} key. An owner or admin manages it.
